note: Bank for prompts/01-vague-feature.txt. HAND-AUTHORED, not captured: it encodes the decisions a real interview on this prompt has to reach, in the exact schema capture-interview.sh emits. Answers are worded to start with distinctive tokens, because run-replay.sh checks the spec for the first two words of each chosen option.
